title: Allow source-root naming with Base MCP enabled and turn-gated control off
outcome: Source-root naming depends on Base MCP availability independently of turn-gated admission, without adding any host-credit, acceptance-evaluation or merge prerequisite.
acceptance: With project Base MCP enabled and turnGatedControl=false, a valid root-session source-root naming request succeeds.
With Base MCP disabled, the existing source-root naming refusal remains; existing ownership, path and identity guards remain effective.
Relevant/new tests and independent read-only reviews accompany the exact candidate in a READY handoff; no acceptance evaluation or host-credit requirement is introduced.
